questionSnapshot.question: What is the name of the adults-only French specialty restaurant aboard the Disney Dream and Disney Fantasy?

notes: Read all four options, relevant full topic digests and cross-bank comparisons. Category and editorial difficulty checked on final wording. Challenged Lumiere's and Triton's because both serve French-influenced meals. Their ship locations and main-dining status fail the full premise; Palo is Italian.
